title: Saudi Arabian Lentil Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic kebab recipe originating from Saudi Arabia, made with tender lentils and spices. This gluten-free dish is perfect for a quick and healthy meal.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the lentils and heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the aromatic, Saudi, and Arabian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lentil mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill seasoning onto the skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lentils are tender and lightly charred.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
